Primary Crops: Rubber (Kottayam is the heartland), Coconut, Tapioca, Pepper, Banana.
Primary Livelihood: Government/Admin (in capital), Service Sector, Rubber Tapping, Coir Industry, Farming.
Population & Demographics: High population density. Thiruvananthapuram is the state capital. Strong Syrian Christian cultural presence in the midland belt.

Geography: Below sea-level basin. Reclaimed backwaters, canals, and paddy fields protected by bunds.
Primary Livelihood: Paddy Farming (specialized), Duck Rearing, Coir Industry, Houseboat Tourism.
Soil Type: Acid Sulfate Soil - Black, clayey, and water-logged.
Population & Demographics: Densely populated and settlements on narrow bunds. Life is entirely centered around water.

Geography: High mountains of the Western Ghats, deep valleys, large reservoirs.
Primary Livelihood: Plantation Labor, spice farming, hydro-power, tourism.
Soil Type:
Acidic Forest Loam. 
 Rich in organic matter, acidic.
Population & Demographics: Lower density, clustered in plantation towns.

Primary Crops: Coconut, Nutmeg, Pineapple, Rice. (Highly urbanized, less agricultural).
Primary Livelihood: Commerce, Trade, IT hub, Port Operations, Service Sector.
Population & Demographics: Highest population density. The cosmopolitan, industrial, and commercial hub of Kerala.

Sub-Region / Area: Kole Region - Parts of Thrissur & Malappuram
Population & Demographics: Farming communities bordering the wetlands. Close to Thrissur, the "Cultural Capital".

Primary Crops: Coconut, Areca nut, Cashew, Pepper, Tapioca.
Primary Livelihood: Agriculture, Gulf Remittances (esp. Malappuram), Trade (Kozhikode), Handlooms (Kannur).
Population & Demographics: High density. Strong Mappila (Muslim) cultural heritage, distinct cuisine, and dialect. Kannur is a hub for Theyyam.

Geography: A large, flat, dry plain forming a gap in the Western Ghats.
Primary Livelihood: Paddy Farming, Toddy Tapping, Small-scale industries.
Weather: Hotter & Drier than the rest of Kerala
Soil Type: Black Cotton Soil, Red Loam. (Unique to this region).
Population & Demographics: High cultural and linguistic overlap with neighboring Tamil Nadu.

Geography: A high-altitude plateau in the Western Ghats.
Primary Crops: Coffee, Black Pepper, Banana, Ginger, Tea.
Population & Demographics: Relatively lower density. Has the largest tribal population in Kerala- Paniya, Adiya tibes

Geography: Rolling laterite hills and a coastal plain with many rivers.
Population & Demographics: A linguistic borderland. High prevalence of Tulu and Kannada speakers. Culturally distinct (Theyyam, Yakshagana).
